name: Hexing Familiar
body:
Your familiar can throw hexes for you.

Prerequisite: Major hex class feature, witch’s familiar class feature.

Benefit: Your familiar can perform any basic hex you know. It cannot perform major or grand hexes. It performs the hex using your caster level and its Intelligence modifier to determine DC and hex effects. The familiar cannot perform a hex in the same round that you perform a hex and vice versa.
